clue.text: Queen brought back — not a republic now

indicators.note: not tells us the following a is dropped from what precedes it
brought back means the word for queen is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: Regina is Latin for queen, as in the royal cipher ER
taken as written

explanation.surface: A monarch is restored and the country is no longer a republic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns REGINA into ANIGER; 'not a' then removes the A. The 'now' points to a former French colony that is a republic today.
explanation.definitionFit: Niger, in West Africa, became an independent republic in 1960 after French colonial rule.

clue.text: Dark suit needed for entertaining here?

parts.note: dark as a noun means night-time
clubs is one of the four suits in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: Someone needs a dark suit to go out entertaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Clubs open at night are venues where people are entertained with music and dancing, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Sentimentality is not, entirely commendable

indicators.note: not entirely means the word is used without its final letter

parts.note: something commendable is good

explanation.surface: A remark that being sentimental is not wholly praiseworthy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not, entirely' clips GOOD to its first three letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Goo is informal for gushing, cloying sentiment, as in sloppy romantic films.

clue.text: Get back, say, into the shower

indicators.note: into means the abbreviation goes inside the word for the shower

parts.note: a shower is a fall of rain
say introduces an example, abbreviated EG

explanation.surface: Someone retreats back into the shower.
explanation.definitionFit: To regain something is to recover or get it back after losing it.

clue.text: Fahrenheit in record drop appears to cause bafflement

parts.note: a gramophone record is a disc

indicators.note: in tells us the F sits inside the word for drop

parts.note: to drop something from a list is to omit it

explanation.surface: A drop in temperature on the record seems to puzzle people.
explanation.definitionFit: To discomfit someone is to disconcert or confuse them, a synonym for causing bafflement.

clue.text: We had this extraordinary destructive feeling

indicators.note: extraordinary suggests the letters are put into an unusual new order

explanation.surface: A group admits to having had a strange urge to wreck things.
explanation.definitionFit: A death wish is a psychological urge toward self-destruction, a destructive feeling.

clue.text: Tough material I cut into four quarters

indicators.note: cut into means the letter I is placed inside the compass letters

parts.note: the four quarters of the compass are south, north, east and west

explanation.surface: Someone slices tough stuff into four pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinew is tendon, the tough fibrous tissue joining muscle to bone.

clue.text: Going round in circles, or being effective?

parts.note: taken as written
biting criticism is sharp and effective

explanation.surface: A question of whether something is just going round in circles or actually working.
explanation.definitionFit: A satellite orbiting a planet travels round it in a circular path.

clue.text: Distant and light, later strong wind that billows out skirts

indicators.note: later puts the wind after the other pieces

parts.note: distant means far
a light fabric is thin
a gale is a strong wind

explanation.surface: A light breeze that later becomes a gale and blows skirts about.
explanation.definitionFit: A farthingale was a hooped frame worn under Tudor skirts to make them spread out wide.

clue.text: Boy's name in miniature

indicators.note: in puts the abbreviation inside the word for miniature

parts.note: a toy dog or toy poodle is a miniature breed

explanation.surface: A little boy is given a diminutive name.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Boy's' as 'Boy is': the definition is the boy, and 's is the link.
explanation.definitionFit: Tony is a common male first name, short for Anthony, so it names a boy.

clue.text: What arable farmer does without wife is material

indicators.note: without means the W is taken out

parts.note: an arable farmer grows grain crops

explanation.surface: A comment on what a crop farmer does without his wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Grosgrain is a heavy ribbed silk or rayon fabric, a dress material.

clue.text: Keep mining out east for component of steel

indicators.note: out means the E is removed

parts.note: to keep mining is to bore on, keep drilling

explanation.surface: Miners are urged to carry on digging out east for steelmaking ore.
explanation.definitionFit: Boron is a chemical element added in small amounts to steel to harden it.

clue.text: Article by blackguard dissected Rembrandt's work

parts.note: the is the definite article
the first half, black, means night
the second half, guard, means watch

explanation.surface: A piece written by a scoundrel takes apart a Rembrandt painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dissected' tells you to split 'blackguard' into BLACK and GUARD and replace each half with a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: The Night Watch is Rembrandt's famous 1642 group portrait of an Amsterdam militia company.

clue.text: Outburst that may find its mark

definitions.text: Outburst that may find its mark

parts.words: Outburst that may find its mark
parts.note: a sudden cry, which in writing is followed by a punctuation mark of its own name

explanation.surface: An angry outburst hits its target.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation is a sudden cry, and in print it ends with the exclamation mark.

clue.text: Worst moment to start, appearing not quite good enough

indicators.note: to start says the moment comes first

parts.note: a second is a brief moment
to worst someone is to defeat them, to best them

explanation.surface: A bad moment at the beginning leaves someone falling short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Worst' is a verb meaning defeat, not the superlative of bad.
explanation.definitionFit: Second-best describes something inferior to the top choice, falling just short of good enough.

clue.text: Lady of fortune

definitions.meaning: Lady ... is the personification of chance

explanation.definitionFit: Luck is chance or fortune, personified as the Lady who favours gamblers.

clue.text: Is boy imprisoned in Charleston? That sounds harsh

indicators.note: imprisoned in puts the first pieces inside the dance

parts.note: the Charleston is a 1920s dance
taken as written
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A boy locked up in the city of Charleston, which sounds harsh.
explanation.walkthrough: Charleston looks like the US city but is the 1920s dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissonance is a clash of discordant sounds, something that sounds harsh.

clue.text: Tears through part of recipe for boiled potatoes?

definitions.meaning: tears are salty water from the eyes

definitions.text: part of recipe for boiled potatoes?
definitions.meaning: potatoes are boiled in water with salt added

explanation.surface: Someone cries through cooking a potato recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Tears consist of salt water, and salted water is used to boil potatoes.

clue.text: Old support for one new spy

indicators.note: support for puts the old word beneath the others, as this is a down clue

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
former means old or earlier

explanation.surface: An old supporter is replaced by a new spy.
explanation.definitionFit: An informer is someone who secretly passes information to the authorities, much like a spy.

clue.text: After knock on the head, youngster gets wheeze

indicators.note: After places the youngster behind the knock

parts.note: to brain someone is to hit them on the head
a child is a youngster

explanation.surface: A child gets a breathing problem after being hit on the head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wheeze' is British slang for a clever scheme or idea.
explanation.definitionFit: A brainchild is a person's own clever idea, which British slang calls a wheeze.

clue.text: Way off, finishing with nothing, in gambling game

indicators.note: finishing with places the zero at the end

parts.note: way off means far
O is the round zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A gambler is well behind and ends up with nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Faro is an old card game played for money, popular in Wild West saloons.

clue.text: Group of horses have made way on to course enclosure

indicators.note: on to puts the way first, joined to the enclosure

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
the ring is the enclosure at a racecourse where bookmakers stand

explanation.surface: Horses make their way onto the racecourse enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: A string is the set of racehorses kept by one owner or trainer.

clue.text: In Sweden, station running wholly at a loss

indicators.note: running suggests the letters are in motion and set in new order

explanation.surface: A traveller in Sweden is completely lost at a railway station.
explanation.definitionFit: At one's wits' end is an idiom for being completely baffled and helpless.

clue.text: Tourist's novel, short and in French

indicators.note: short means the last letter is cut

parts.note: Emma is a novel by Jane Austen
et is French for and

explanation.surface: A tourist reads a brief French novel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts EMMA to EMM; 'Tourist's' reads as 'Tourist is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Emmet, dialect for ant, is Cornish slang for a tourist or holidaymaker.

clue.text: Thrash with good smack

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to thrash them

explanation.surface: Someone thrashes another with a good slap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'smack' is a taste here, not a slap.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack of something is a trace of its flavour, which a tang also is.

clue.text: It's taken for granted it's an honour to be on a team

indicators.note: to be on puts the honour after the rest

parts.note: taken as written
XI is Roman eleven, a cricket or football team
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A player finds it an honour to be picked for a team.
explanation.definitionFit: An axiom is a self-evident truth accepted without proof, a premise assumed.

clue.text: Lose pounds in systematic transformation

parts.note: not dieting but converting imperial weights such as pounds to the metric system

explanation.surface: A dieter sheds weight through a methodical regime.
explanation.definitionFit: To metricate is to convert measurements to the metric system, abandoning pounds for kilograms.

clue.text: Difficulty putting a party together.

parts.note: taken as written
a do is a party

explanation.surface: Organising a party causes difficulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Ado means fuss or trouble, as in without further ado.

clue.text: It gives power to right, after army chief's deposed left

indicators.note: after places the first pieces behind the trimmed army chief
deposed means the L is removed

parts.note: a general is an army chief
taken as written

explanation.surface: Power goes to the right after the army chief's left-wing regime is overthrown.
explanation.definitionFit: A generator is a machine that produces electrical power.

clue.text: Look triumphant, with meal at last put in billy

indicators.note: put in places that letter inside the goat

parts.note: a billy is a male goat

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of meal

explanation.surface: Someone with a goat finally fed is looking pleased.
explanation.walkthrough: 'billy' is the billy goat, not a cooking can.
explanation.definitionFit: To gloat is to look on with smug triumph over another's misfortune.
